title.narrative: Stöd till Kakheti Regional Development Foundation
Support to Kakheti Regional Development Foundation

description.narrative: Bidraget riktar sig till kvinnor och ungdomar samt socialt utsatta familjer i de samhällen som främst bebos av etniska och religiösa minoriteter i Kakheti-regionen. Genom att stödja den sociala integrationen bland marginaliserade grupper kommer kvinnor och ungdomar att få bättre förutsättningar att på ett meningsfullt sätt delta i det civila och ekonomiska livet och bidra till att bygga ett inkluderande och rättvist samhälle.

The contribution targets women and youth, and also socially vulnerable families in the targeted communities mainly inhabited by ethnic and religious minorities in Kakheti region. Supporting the social integration among marginalized communities will enable women and youth to be better positioned to meaningfully participate in civic and economic life and contribute to building an inclusive and equitable communities/society.

Objectives of the project are :
Economic and Social Empowerment of Women: The cooperation partner intends to achieve this objective through a variety of activities, including educational courses, capacity building for teachers, women empowerment trainings, entrepreneurship schools, and professional empowerment masterclasses. These activities are designed to enhance the skills, knowledge, and confidence of ethnic minority women, leading to increased economic independence, social participation, and entrepreneurship.
Intercultural Dialogue and Awareness: Through youth empowerment programs such as weekly sessions, cultural festivals, community dialogues, trainings, workshops, and sport competitions, the cooperation partner aims to promote understanding and cooperation among youth from diverse backgrounds.
And the last objective is to enhance KRDFs capacity and its effectiveness in implementing projects, achieving desired outcomes, and fostering positive socio-economic change at the local level

Under the strategic objective 1 that is formulated "Providing free educational and vocational activities to locally vulnerable youth and women" the following has been done before the termination of the project: In total, 256 students attended the courses in 4 Education Centers in all target municipalities. The courses were given in Georgian and English languages, math, but also vocational course were delivered in culinary, sewing, pottery making, etc. Apart of those courses training were conducted in misinformation about Eurointegration. It aimed to give women and youth correct information and encourage them to take part in democratic processes.
Under thestrategic objective 2 "To enhance social integration in the communities including ethnic and religious minorities in Kakheti region through intercultural dialogue and awareness raising" the project KRDF held training sessions on inclusiveness and integration for young people from different ethnic backgrounds. They also organized camps and weekly development sessions in Akhmeta and Pankisi, giving young people a chance to connect and learn from each other. Total 58 girls and boys participated in camps organised by KRDF
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
